name: Abolition of the Cossack Order in Sloboda Ukraine (1765) (C0031)

techniques.comment: The liquidation of Cossack administrative units and the introduction of imperial division: the report of the Shakhovskoy-Panin commission confirmed by the empress on December 16, 1764 and Catherine II's manifesto of July 28, 1765(Citation: Высочайше утвержденный доклад князя Шаховского, генерал-аншефа Панина об учреждении Слободской губернии 1764)(Citation: Манифест об учреждении в Слободских полках гражданского устройства 1765) – "On the basis of the Sloboda regiments the Sloboda-Ukrainian Governorate was formed"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).

The forced incorporation of the autochthonous armed forces into the imperial army: "The Sloboda Cossack regiments were abolished and in their place it was ordered to form 5 hussar regiments"(Citation: Історія Слобідської України 1918).

Lowering the social status of the indigenous population for the purpose of economic extraction: "The Cossacks and their helpers were turned into military settlers and taxed with the poll tax," and those with the right to distill horilka "now had to pay… 95 kopecks per soul to the treasury"(Citation: Історія Слобідської України 1918).
